decisions.reason: As an award-backed yogurt close to the core cultured-dairy range, it is still relatively inexpensive to carry and the available evidence is not negative enough to justify withdrawal.
Because management positioned it as a flagship cheese and it fits the established business very well, its expected value remains strong enough to continue.
After several years, this semi-hard cheese has shown no clear standout signal and its option value now looks lower than the benefit of reallocating resources to stronger core items and new projects.
The spicy cheese line offered useful learning at launch, but by now the uncertainty has largely resolved and a multi-variant line without stronger evidence is costly to keep open.
This mild creamy soft cheese broadens the familiar soft-cheese assortment at limited incremental cost, so without clearer signs of failure it is worth retaining.
